{{Short description|Trusted-server-querying method for public key certificate information}}
{{onesource|date=February 2012}}
'''Delegated Path Discovery''' ('''DPD''') is a method for querying a trusted server for information about a [[public key certificate]].

DPD allows [[Client (computing)|clients]] to obtain collated certificate information from a trusted DPD [[Server (computing)|server]]. This information may then be used by the client to validate the subject certificate.

The requirements for DPD are described in RFC 3379. <ref>{{Cite report |url=https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/rfc3379/ |title=Delegated Path Validation and Delegated Path Discovery Protocol Requirements |last=Housley |first=Russ |last2=Pinkas |first2=Denis |date=September 2002 |publisher=Internet Engineering Task Force |issue=RFC 3379}}</ref>
